Remark
↗ lem:hopfs-lemma 1. ch6:6.4-rem-3\group Maximum Principles

Part (i) strengthens the obvious non-strict inequality to $\frac{\partial u}{\partial \nu }(x^0)>0$. The interior ball condition holds when $\partial U$ is $C^2$.
